briefdescription.para: Writes a Unicode codepoint to the active screen at the cursor position.

detaileddescription.para: This is the primary character output function. It handles two distinct cases based on the Unicode grapheme segmentation result:

simplesect.title: Case 1 — Grapheme cluster extension (segResult.addToCurrentCell())
simplesect.para: The codepoint is a combining character, variation selector, or other non-spacing mark that extends the previous grapheme cluster. Grapheme cluster extension deferred — Grid needs a grapheme sidecar.

listitem.para: Any pending wrap is resolved via resolveWrapPending().
If the character is wide (width 2) and would overflow the right margin, the cursor wraps to the next line (if auto-wrap is enabled).
A packed jam::Char is built from the codepoint, styleId (via Stamp), and wide hint. The cell is written to Grid via getWritePointer().
For wide characters, a second cell with SPACER_TAIL is written to the adjacent column.
The cursor is advanced by cellWidth columns, or wrapPending is set if the cursor has reached the right margin.

detaileddescription.para: Sets the scrolling region to rows Pt–Pb (one-based). After setting the region, the cursor is moved to the home position.

parameterdescription.para: CSI parameters (P0 = top, P1 = bottom, both 1-based).

briefdescription.para: Handles CSI 6 n — Device Status Report, Cursor Position (CPR).

detaileddescription.para: Queues a ESC[<row>;<col>R response in responseBuf. Row and column are one-based in the response.

parameterdescription.para: CSI parameters (must contain Pn = 6 to reach this handler).

briefdescription.para: Handles CSI c / CSI ?

detaileddescription.para: c — Device Attributes (DA1).
Queues a primary device attributes response identifying this terminal as a VT220-compatible device.

parameterdescription.para: true if the sequence was CSI ? c (secondary DA), false if it was CSI c (primary DA).

briefdescription.para: Handles CSI Ps J — Erase in Display (ED).

entry.para: Erase from cursor to end of screen
Erase from start of screen to cursor

briefdescription.para: Handles CSI Ps K — Erase in Line (EL).

entry.para: Erase from cursor to end of line
Erase from start of line to cursor

briefdescription.para: Handles CSI Pn L — Insert Lines (IL).

detaileddescription.para: Inserts count blank lines at the cursor row, pushing existing lines down. Lines that fall below the scroll region bottom are discarded.

briefdescription.para: Handles CSI Pn M — Delete Lines (DL).

detaileddescription.para: Deletes count lines starting at the cursor row, pulling subsequent lines up. Blank lines are inserted at the scroll region bottom.

briefdescription.para: Shared implementation for IL (insert lines) and DL (delete lines).

detaileddescription.para: Shifts lines within the scrolling region starting at the cursor row.

parameterdescription.para: true to shift lines up (DL), false to shift down (IL).

briefdescription.para: Handles CSI Pn @ — Insert Characters (ICH).

detaileddescription.para: Inserts count blank cells at the cursor position, shifting existing cells to the right. Cells that fall beyond the right margin are discarded.

parameterdescription.para: Number of blank cells to insert (>= 1).

briefdescription.para: Handles CSI Pn P — Delete Characters (DCH).

detaileddescription.para: Deletes count cells starting at the cursor position, pulling subsequent cells to the left. Blank cells are inserted at the right margin.

briefdescription.para: Handles CSI Pn X — Erase Characters (ECH).

detaileddescription.para: Replaces count cells starting at the cursor position with blank cells using the current background colour. The cursor does not move.

briefdescription.para: Handles CSI Ps b — Repeat preceding graphic character (REP).
Switches between the normal and alternate screen buffers.

detaileddescription.para: When switching to the alternate screen, the normal screen state is saved and the alternate screen is cleared. When switching back, the normal screen state is restored. Corresponds to the ?1049h / ?1049l private mode sequences.

parameterdescription.para: true to activate the alternate screen, false to return to the normal screen.

briefdescription.para: Appends a null-terminated response string to responseBuf.

detaileddescription.para: Accumulates device responses during action processing so they can be delivered in a single write after processing completes. If the response would overflow responseBuf, it is silently truncated.

briefdescription.para: Maximum number of characters accepted from an OSC title string.

detaileddescription.para: Applied when extracting the window title from an OSC 0 or OSC 2 sequence. Titles longer than this are truncated before being written to State.

briefdescription.para: Live viewport cell grid — 2 channels (normal + alternate), cols × visibleRows.

detaileddescription.para: Disposable scratch. Resized by setWinsize() while processing is suspended. Session reads this via getGrid() on the message thread for the flush path. Neovim ScreenGrid sense: the live viewport cell matrix.

briefdescription.para: Per-channel Block views into the owned buffer.

detaileddescription.para: Index 0 = normal screen channel, 1 = alternate screen channel. Video writes cells through blocks.at(activeScreen). Rebuilt by setWinsize() after every buffer resize.

briefdescription.para: Events map owned by Processor.

detaileddescription.para: Video fires events through this map.

Registered event keys fired by Video:
"writeToHost" — (const char*, int) — device response bytes, reader thread
"bell" — () — BEL character, dispatched via callAsync
"clipboardChanged" — (const juce::String&) — OSC 52, dispatched via callAsync
"desktopNotification" — (const juce::String&, const juce::String&) — OSC 9/777, dispatched via callAsync
"imageDecoded" — image pixel data + placement metadata, reader thread
"previewFile" — (const juce::String&, int, int, int, int) — reader thread
"dcsPayloadComplete" — (const uint8_t*, int) — DCS ST received, reader thread
"apcPayloadComplete" — (const uint8_t*, int) — APC ST/BEL received, reader thread
"activeScreen" / "cursor" — flush(), reader thread. "cursor" is packed CursorState (row+col+visible+kbFlags).
"applicationCursor" / "bracketedPaste" / mode flags — (bool) — flush(), reader thread

simplesect.para: READER THREAD — events are fired on the reader thread; callAsync handlers land on the message thread.

briefdescription.para: Final byte from DCS header, recorded by storeDCSHeader() for dispatch in applyDCSPayload().
Current foreground colour.

detaileddescription.para: Alpha == 0 = theme default.

briefdescription.para: Current background colour.

detaileddescription.para: Alpha == 0 = theme default.

briefdescription.para: Current SGR bitmask (jam::Stamp::BOLD etc.).
Cached styleId — updated lazily on cell write.
True when penFg / penBg / penFlags changed since last styleId lookup.
Per-screen DECSC saved cursor state (normal / alternate).
Last graphic character printed, for REP (CSI Ps b).
Grid row of the most recently written base cell — used by grapheme cluster extension.
Grid column of the most recently written base cell — used by grapheme cluster extension.
Whether the VT100 line-drawing character set is active in GL.

detaileddescription.para: When true, printable bytes in the range 0x60–0x7E are mapped to box-drawing characters (DEC Special Graphics). Set by SO (0x0E) when G1 contains line-drawing, cleared by SI (0x0F) to return to G0.

briefdescription.para: Whether G0 is designated as DEC Special Graphics (ESC ( 0).
Whether G1 is designated as DEC Special Graphics (ESC ) 0).
Unicode grapheme segmentation state for cluster boundary detection.

detaileddescription.para: Tracks the Unicode grapheme cluster break algorithm state across successive codepoints. Used by print() to decide whether a new codepoint starts a new cluster or extends the previous one.

briefdescription.para: Buffer for device response strings queued during action processing.

detaileddescription.para: Responses (DA, CPR, …) are written here by sendResponse() rather than sent immediately. flushResponses() delivers the accumulated content through the "writeToHost" event after Parser's process() returns.

briefdescription.para: Number of valid bytes currently stored in responseBuf.

detaileddescription.para: Reset to zero by flushResponses() after delivery.

briefdescription.para: Link ID of the currently active OSC 8 hyperlink, or 0 when no link is open.

detaileddescription.para: Set by handleOsc8() via Processor event handler when an OSC 8 open is received. Cleared to 0 on OSC 8 close. Stamped onto every cell written by print() while non-zero.
Lives in Video (not the pen cell) because hyperlink state must not survive DECSC/DECRC cursor save/restore.

briefdescription.para: Constructs Video, allocates the owned Buffer and builds Block views.

detaileddescription.para: Allocates a 2-channel grid (normal + alternate) with rows visible rows and cols columns. Builds per-channel Block views into the grid. The owner must call setWinsize() after Display/Screen exist to synchronise internal geometry before the first process() call.

parameterdescription.para: Events map owned by Processor. Video fires events through this map instead of holding std::function callbacks directly.

simplesect.para: MESSAGE THREAD — construction happens before the reader thread starts.

briefdescription.para: Resets Video and the terminal to a clean initial state.

detaileddescription.para: Performs a full terminal reset (RIS — Reset to Initial State).
Clears the pen, cursor, scroll region, tab stops, and all mode flags. Equivalent to a hard terminal reset (RIS, ESC c).

READER THREAD only.
Equivalent to the ESC c sequence. Restores the terminal to a clean power-on state:
Resets activeScreen to normal.
Homes the cursor via resetCursor().
Resets all mode flags via resetModes().
Resets the active pen via resetPen().
Disables the line-drawing charset.
Fires id::clearBuffer event to clear the normal screen.
Calls calc() to synchronise internal cached geometry.

briefdescription.para: Marks the pen style cache dirty and recomputes cached geometry.

detaileddescription.para: Marks penStyleDirty so that currentStyleId() will re-query the Stamp table on the next cell write. Called internally by setWinsize() and reset().

READER THREAD only.
setWinsize()
Sets penStyleDirty so that currentStyleId() will re-query the Stamp table on the next cell write. Must be called after construction and after every setWinsize(). Also called internally by cursorSetScrollRegion() and cursorResetScrollRegion().

briefdescription.para: Delivers any queued device responses to the host via the writeToHost event.

detaileddescription.para: Delivers all queued response bytes to the host via the "writeToHost" event.

During action processing, responses (DA, CPR, …) are accumulated in responseBuf rather than sent immediately. Call this method after Parser's process() returns to flush the buffer through the "writeToHost" handler registered in the events map.

READER THREAD only.
sendResponse()
Processor::events
Called by the owner (Session) after each process() invocation. If responseLen > 0 and the "writeToHost" handler is registered in the events map, the entire responseBuf is passed to the handler and responseLen is reset to zero.

briefdescription.para: Returns the styleId for the current pen state, updating the cache if dirty.

detaileddescription.para: Looks up or inserts the current {penFg, penBg, penFlags} triple in the Stamp table and caches the result in penStyleId until one of the pen components changes. Called by print() and currentStyleId().

briefdescription.para: Returns a styleId with the current background but default fg and zero flags.

detaileddescription.para: Per VT spec, erase operations clear cells using the current SGR background but ignore all text attributes (fg colour, bold, italic, etc.). Alpha == 0 for fg signals the renderer to substitute the theme default.

briefdescription.para: Returns the effective bottom row of the current scrolling region.

detaileddescription.para: Uses the single active scrollBottom register and current visible rows.

effectiveScrollBottom()
Reads from Grid buffer dims (safe on reader thread) on every call. Wraps effectiveScrollBottom() with the current screen and visible rows.

briefdescription.para: VT command processor: receives decoded actions, writes Buffer, holds calculation inputs.

detaileddescription.para: Video is the VT command processor. It receives decoded semantic actions from Parser and translates them into mutations of the cell buffer. It holds calculation inputs: the drawing pen, cursor state (both normal and alternate screens), scroll region, tab stops, charset selection, and response buffering.

listitem.para: Construct with references to a jam::Buffer<jam::Row> and the events map.
Call setWinsize() after construction to synchronise internal geometry.
Parser calls action methods (print(), applyControlCode(), applyCSI(), …) on the reader thread as bytes are decoded.
Call flushResponses() after each process() pass to deliver any queued device responses through the "writeToHost" event handler in the events map.

simplesect.title: Events
simplesect.para: Video fires events through the events map reference received at construction. Processor owns the map; Session registers handlers on it. Events are fired on the READER THREAD; handlers dispatched via callAsync land on the message thread.
All methods are READER THREAD only unless otherwise stated.
Parser — DFA decoder that drives action methods on this class
CSI — CSI parameter accumulator passed to dispatch handlers
Buffer — cell buffer target for print and erase operations
